title: Three image upload paths accept any image/* type including SVG and take the file extension from the visitor filename, then store to the public event-media bucket.

source.ref: Whole-site audit 2026-11-16 (project thread, requested by Daniel). Confidence: PLAUSIBLE. Audit file: audit/FINAL-BUILD-AND-REPAIR-LIST-2026-11-16.md

detail:
EVIDENCE: lib/spaces/space-image-store.ts:15 and app/(main)/journeys/actions.ts:165 only check file.type.startsWith('image/'); app/(main)/events/[slug]/social-actions.ts:244-249 does the same, uploads with contentType: file.type and a path built from the raw file name (any guest of an event can do this). Contrast app/(main)/circles/admin-actions.ts:463-467 and events/admin-actions.ts:1048 which use an explicit raster allowlist and note SVG as stored XSS. Uploads use createAdminClient (service role).

WHY IT MATTERS: An image/svg+xml file with script is served from the storage CDN URL with an executable content type. Supabase storage adds a sandbox CSP on objects, which probably blunts it, so this is hardening, not a known exploit; the fix is cheap and the two safe call sites already show the pattern.

FIX DIRECTION: Reuse the circles allowlist (jpeg/png/webp/gif/avif) or the Loom ingest pipeline in all three places and derive the extension from the validated type, not the filename.

2026-11-16 fixed (security thread): new lib/storage/raster-image.ts sniffs the file bytes against a raster allowlist (jpeg/png/webp/gif/avif, no SVG); the space image store, journey cover and event photo uploads now use the verified type as contentType and derive the extension from it, not the visitor file name.

verify.note: Fails on 2026-11-16 (audit run). Passes when the fix lands. Audit-written probes are direction checks; retime only with Daniel's phrase.
